subject: English
title: Robo the Robot
subtitle: A friend who always helps
hero_picture: A girl with a purple cap and a friendly silver robot with a small screen on its chest playing in a flower garden in front of a house.

sections.heading: Zia and Robo
text: Zia and Robo were playing in the garden.
sections.caption: Zia and Robo
sections.picture: A girl in a purple cap and a friendly silver robot playing among flowers in a garden.

sections.heading: Find the key
text: Mother could not find the key of the shelf.
Beep... beep... a light flashed on Robo's screen.
'The key is in the dust bin!' 'Wow, Robo, you are so good!'
sections.caption: Find the key
sections.picture: A silver robot with a glowing chest screen pointing at a dust bin, a mother and girl looking surprised.

sections.heading: The robot umbrella
text: Zia and Robo went for a walk. It started raining.
Booom... Robo became a big umbrella.
sections.caption: The robot umbrella
sections.picture: A girl standing in the rain under a big colourful umbrella shaped from a robot.

sections.heading: The lost cap
text: A crow took away Zia's cap. A strong wind blew it far.
Zoop! Robo grew big and flew Zia over the trees.
sections.caption: The lost cap
sections.picture: A silver robot flying over trees and houses with a girl on its back.

sections.heading: A new friend
text: In the park, a boy with a walker had the cap.
Robo turned into a wheelchair for him.
'Take Robo with you. He will always help you,' said Zia.
sections.caption: A new friend
sections.picture: A smiling boy in a blue wheelchair in a park, a girl in a purple cap waving goodbye happily.

activity: Draw your own robot. What special thing can your robot do?
talk: How did Robo help in the rain?
Why did Zia give Robo to the boy?
summary: Robo the robot helps everyone; Zia shares her friend with a boy who needs help.

questions.explanation: Robo's screen showed the key in the dust bin.

questions.prompt: What did Robo become in the rain?
questions.explanation: Booom... Robo became a big umbrella.
A crow took away Zia's cap.

questions.prompt: What did Robo become for the boy?
